source: Read-only GROUP BY status,last_error over current TennisPlayerRefreshJob table.

code_interpretation.SEARCH_COMPLETED_NO_MATCH: Search completed without a profile match; retry is scheduled after six hours.
code_interpretation.NO_ALTERNATIVE_PROFILE_DATA: No profile match after previously rejected source IDs were excluded.
code_interpretation.PROFILE_TIMEOUT_PROCESS_TERMINATED: Browser child exceeded its configured deadline or lost the lease and was terminated; bounded exponential retry.
code_interpretation.HISTORY_PAGINATION_INCOMPLETE: Profile page was parsed but terminal pagination proof was missing; data stays partial/stale and is retried.
code_interpretation.RESULTS_SECTION_NOT_LOADED: Profile results section did not load.
code_interpretation.SEARCH_HTTP_ERROR: Profile search endpoint returned an HTTP error.
code_interpretation.PREEMPTED_FOR_CURRENT_EVENT: Archive/profile refresh was preempted to free capacity for a current event.
code_interpretation.REFRESH_ABORTED: Default failure sentinel before all refresh stages complete; this value alone does not identify root cause.
code_interpretation.source_unavailable: Source/transport unavailable; grouping is coarse because the stored code does not preserve every underlying exception.

operational_decision: No bulk retry/reset applied. Keep waiting-confirmation, source failures, process timeouts, and incomplete pagination separated; inspect age and linked worker logs before changing retry policy.
limitations: This is a point-in-time census, not a per-job forensic root-cause audit.
It does not prove queue completion or Chromium recovery.
One new PROFILE_TIMEOUT_PROCESS_TERMINATED retry from the restart acceptance is included.
